title: Unlocking Mongolia's underground copper
summary: Oyu Tolgoi is projected to become one of the world’s most important new copper sources, at a time when high-quality deposits are becoming harder to find and more complex to develop.
body_markdown:
## Related stories


### Oyu Tolgoi underground


Our world-class open pit mine and underground project using block-caving mining techniques to extract the ore and transport it to the surface.


### What is block caving?


Block caving is an innovative underground mining method that uses gravity to help extract ore from deep copper and gold deposits.
